source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_10/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_10_0 and Source5_10_1 on school_name (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
